title: 14.30 Operator Shell - Menu, Availability, Docks, and Gesture Arbitration
authority_note: The Master Spec module is the single source of truth. This file records, for each clause anchor, WHERE that clause was derived from, so a reviewer can audit the derivation. It is provenance ONLY: it is not co-authority, the spec never cites it as a source of contract, and deleting it weakens no clause. Per SAD-008 operator_reinforcement_20260904, a capable model with no chat context and no access to the green room must be able to build the shell, and derive the microtask set, from the spec module alone.
authority_order: 1. studio-integrated-ui-design.json (ADJUDICATION) wins over the three source proposals wherever they differ.
4. studio-menu-architecture.json / studio-panel-dock-architecture.json / studio-tools-tooltips-architecture.json are detail only.
5. installed_exports/** capture records are measurement; a capture beats a proposal's citation of an earlier revision of that same capture.

ADJ.role: ADJUDICATION - the authority. Reconciled the three source proposals, resolved 22 contradictions, folded in the compositing teardown all three predate. Supersedes MENU, PANEL and TOOLS wherever they differ.

SAD.role: Operator-confirmed architecture decisions SAD-001..008 plus green-room defect GRD-001. Binding.

MENU.role: Source proposal 1 of 3: menu tree. Detail only; never preferred over ADJ.

PANEL.role: Source proposal 2 of 3: dock model and panels. Detail only; never preferred over ADJ.

TOOLS.role: Source proposal 3 of 3: tools, tooltips, scrub control. Detail only; never preferred over ADJ.

AE-CMD.role: Capture record: 1,305 menu items in 227 groups, 673 bindings in 32 contexts, 665 labelled commands in 31 categories, 22 palette tools.

AE-PAN.role: Capture record: 16 factory workspaces with splitter trees, 28 panel ids, 405 control-tree surfaces, 6,137 controls, 144 dialog surfaces.

AE-FX.role: Capture record: 635 effects in 46 categories, 1,573 typed parameter records, 833 hard bounds, 606 soft, 366 differing, 327 cannot-time-vary, 359 support URLs to 225 pages.

AE-LPM.role: Capture record: 1,326 match names, 759 containment edges, 13 property group topics, keyframe record format, expression container.

AE-EXP.role: Capture record: 333 expression identifiers in 12 categories, 37 unbound argument signatures, 1,751 scripting members.

AE-RND.role: Capture record: 29 exporters, 35 importers, 32 render/output dialog surfaces carrying 989 controls.

SPEC205.role: v02.205 baseline. Clauses cited here remain in force; this module extends them.

HS.role: handshake_authored - no capture or deliberation source. Authored to make the spec self-standing under the no-context completeness test. Flagged so authored content stays countable.
